intent: Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ tests (reactor-test StepVerifier for Mono/Flux, Mockito for collaborators, no external services, no Thread.sleep) for CorrelationWebFilter. Assert ONLY against the ast_hints method table; at least one given/when/then case per table method and per branch. Unit contract: Context Telemetry Ingestion & Validation correlation middleware (single unit): WebFilter adopting the inbound X-Request-Id header (via CorrelationContext.headerName()) when it is non-blank, at most 128 characters and matches [A-Za-z0-9._-], otherwise generating a random UUID; writes it to the response header and into the Reactor Context under CorrelationContext.contextKey() with contextWrite around chain.filter(exchange). Self-registered with @Component and the highest precedence order (not produced by the wiring unit). No logger, no MDC. Assert on captured surfaces: response header present, Reactor Context key observed by a downstream Mono, adopted vs generated ids, invalid header replaced.
